title: Principal LLM binding update
description: Body of PUT /v1/me/llm/{role}: choose a catalog profile (ADR 0041) or a private endpoint (ADR 0045). profile_id is always required. For a private bind, set private_endpoint_id and set profile_id to that endpoint's profile_id (from GET endpoint). For a catalog bind, omit private_endpoint_id. Optional voice and language for speech roles (ADR 0043). The role is the path.

private_endpoint_id.description: When set, binds this role to a private self-hosted endpoint; profile_id must be that endpoint's profile_id.

model_id.description: Required when the catalog entry or private endpoint lists several models; otherwise must match or be omitted.

voice.description: Provider voice id for role tts. Ignored for other roles.

language.description: BCP 47 language for role tts or stt. Ignored for other roles.
